answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 25350 Country: DZ Title: Can we use tooth past while fasting ? Question: can we use tooth past while fasting Answer ID: 25350 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1866/1348/H=1431) No, you cannot do so, and if the elements of toothpaste will enter into the throat the fast shall be nullified. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
